QuestInfo.name: Transmission Failure
QuestInfo.0: Your most excellent manservant, #p1401000#, has already ordered you a Mount. Keep your fingers crossed that it doesn't look silly.
QuestInfo.1: #p1401000# ordered you a convertible, custom-made by the alchemists in #m261000000#, but it's not here yet. Why should you have to wait? Go see #p2111008# in #m261000000# right away!
QuestInfo.2: #p2111008# seemed very surprised when you asked him about your ride.

0.0: I ordered you a rather flashy convertible automobile. I thought it would suit your image. It is a custom model, much like the #m150000000#, being built by a very capable alchemist in #m261000000# \r\n#L0##bA lot of those words sounded made-up, but I'm very excited!#l\n#k
0.1: Of course you are, master. Your vehicle is being crafted from the finest materials. The delivery date was today, but there have been some delays. \r\n#L0##bSeriously?! I hate delays! I want to see it!#l\n#k
0.2: Well, you could go there yourself if you're feeling that impatient. It might save us a bit on the delivery fee.

yes.0: There is a Zenumist alchemist named #p2111008# in #m261000000#. He is the one working on your vehicle. You should take this Order Request along as well.

no.0: Alright then. I can wait if you can.

1.0: So busy! Whaddaya want? You interested in joining the Zenumists or something? New recruits need to check in with Sir Carso-WHOA!

yes.0: Oh, uh, hey. Nice Order Request you got there. The convertible, yeah? Well, uh, it's... you know... we're workin' on it.

npc.0: You haven't gone to #m261000000#? I sent the order to #p2111008#, a Zenumist alchemist.

item.0: Man oh man, of all the things to break, why'd it have to be a Lidium Engine?! I can't afford that! I'm gonna have to sell my organs!

lost.0: You lost the Order Request? Well, I do have a replacement, but this is very unlike you, master. Are you feeling well?
